name: Daniel Boone Hotel (Charleston, West Virginia)
scope: The surviving Daniel Boone Hotel, now an office building, at 405 Capitol Street in Charleston, West Virginia, with the ten-story blond brick exterior, stepped side elevation, two-story base, and pale terra-cotta crown.
era: The former hotel after its 1980s conversion, as shown in the 2009 Qualla photograph.

originalReview.notes: Corner view of the original low base, weathered buff brick, pale decorative shaft windows, court notch and top balustrade.

review.method: Exactly matched public-domain originals, native building footprint and published architectural dimensions.
review.notes: Qualla's exact exterior photo matches Pubdog's public-domain self-release, preserved by the same-size original Wikimedia transfer record.
